title: Remove Duplicates with ROW_NUMBER
description: Identify and remove duplicate customer records using ROW_NUMBER.

data.text: Write a query to find duplicate customer records (same Email) and show which ones to keep.

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
WITH DuplicateCTE AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        Email,
        CustomerName,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Email ORDER BY CustomerID) AS RowNum
    FROM Customers
)
SELECT CustomerID, Email, CustomerName, RowNum
FROM DuplicateCTE
WHERE RowNum > 1
ORDER BY Email;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: ROW_NUMBER assigns a unique number within each partition (Email group). The first occurrence (RowNum = 1) is the one to keep; rows with RowNum > 1 are duplicates. To delete: DELETE FROM DuplicateCTE WHERE RowNum > 1. This pattern is essential for data cleaning.
